mode: Built-in image_gen for eight sequential acting poses per emote; Canvas/GIF encoding for timing, effects and captions

prompts.COOKED:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production animation sprite sheet for ONE Twitch emote, not separate unrelated illustrations. Exactly 8 equally sized square cells in a strict 4 columns by 2 rows grid, 2048x1024 overall if possible. Transparent alpha across entire sheet. No visible grid, borders, labels, captions, or text. Each cell is a consecutive animation pose, reading left to right then next row. Every creature must remain fully contained within its own cell, generous 10% transparent padding, identical scale and baseline.
Reference image is a CHARACTER STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: fierce Udyr-inspired orange phoenix spirit with cyan flame tips and glowing eyes. Simplify to bold clean cel-shaded fantasy emote art, limited chunky feather shapes, no cute baby proportions. This is full character acting with changing wing joints and head angle, not a static image moved around.
8 consecutive poses of the phoenix CASTING A FIRESTORM:
1. wings folded down, head lowered, gathering energy, no effects.
2. wings drawing backward, head lifts, small flame orb between claws.
3. wings lifted high over head, fire orb grows to fist size.
4. wings sweep sharply forward, beak opens to cast, orange fire ribbon leaves claws to right.
5. fully extended wings thrust forward, large curved fire arc sweeps around lower body.
6. wings following through downward, head forward, short swirling fire vortex in front.
7. flames settle, phoenix leans back with triumphant fierce grin, wings at hips.
8. returns close to pose 1 with wings lowering, ready for loop.
Keep face and anatomy consistent across all 8 poses. Each cell is isolated with true transparent background, no scenery, no UI, no lettering. Avoid mixing poses across cell boundaries. No objects touch panel edges.
